content.text: Added 'limitations' column with data for 2/2 papers.

h3xa0h6e59g5.data:
- The paper does not explicitly mention any limitations of the study.
- The authors focus on the introduction of Activation Transport Operators and their empirical evaluation without discussing potential shortcomings.
- There is no reference to the constraints or challenges faced during the implementation of the proposed methods.
- The authors do not address the generalizability of their findings across different models or datasets.
- The study lacks a discussion on the potential impact of noise or variability in the data on the results obtained.

v7yqvcdc37it.data:
- The study relies on idealized assumptions or additional constraints that may not be present in standard self-attention (SA) mechanisms.
- The analysis may not fully capture the complexities of more general SA architectures that do not admit an energy function.
- The focus on the Jacobian matrix may overlook other important factors influencing inference dynamics.
- The findings regarding normalization layers and their role in dynamics may not be universally applicable across all SA models.
- The proposed regularization methods and pseudo-energy for monitoring dynamics may require further validation in practical applications.
